name: @ai-games/core
description: Tiny raw-WebGPU runtime, no engine: initGPU, fixed-timestep loop, Input, OrbitCamera, MeshRenderer (lambert + hemisphere WGSL, instancing via storage buffer), texture bake from TextureRecipe WGSL bodies, spring/easing helpers, DOM fps overlay. Public API is pinned; stub bodies throw 'not implemented: <name>' until built.
